history.expected: Reject excessive filter trees and operand lists before SQL.
Paginate distinct roots across multiple to-many joins without omissions.
Stop include traversal at the cap before mass hydration.
Reject unsupported composite identifiers during resource/route discovery with a diagnostic.
Two writers with the same validator produce one success and one 412 without loser mutation.
Unique create race yields 201 and JSON:API 409, with exactly one row.
Reject Atomic batches spanning independent managers/shards before mutation.
A single-connection PostgreSQL Atomic batch commits only PostgreSQL, succeeds even when an unused MySQL commit would fail, and persists its final state.
history.current: The scoped transaction provider does not enlist the unrelated MySQL connection.
history.interpretation: Cross-connection Atomic must be rejected before mutation; same-connection Atomic must preserve all-or-nothing rollback. No distributed transaction is required.
